brief: Found by R10-SETPOINT-BOOST's census: with a 750 L manual-valve buffer configured, the planner publishes the same plans as with no buffer, and the tank stays at its start temperature, so the buffer is never used as a heat store for cheap windows. This affects the owner's install type. Root-cause on synthetic installs, then make the buffer's storage credit drive pre-heating in cheap windows within the comfort band. Controls: flat-price null, buffer and no-buffer arms, mutation.
